_doc: Corrections applied by dev-tools/build-geo.php on top of the GeoNames dumps.
Keys per country: admin1_rename {code: name}, admin1_strip_suffix, admin2_strip_suffix,
The build fails when the counts in 'expect' do not match after the corrections.
Codes are never changed (members store them); only names are fixed and duplicates dropped.
Checked 2026-10-26 against the official structure: 36 states + the Federal Capital Territory, 774 LGAs.
GeoNames lists 785 second-level areas: 11 are later duplicates (geonameid 948xxxx, named '... Local Government Area')
of LGAs already present under an older, sometimes misspelled name. The duplicates are dropped and the older
entries renamed to the official spelling. Two of the 948xxxx entries (Lagos Mainland, Lagos Island) are real
LGAs that have no older entry and are kept. Benue's 'Bukuru' is Buruku LGA (Bukuru is a town in Plateau State).
Admin1 names mix 'X State' and 'X': the suffix is dropped so every state reads the same; FCT is spelled out.
England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland as the first level; counties and council areas below.
